title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: The Tianji Record shows Ye Qing has blood resonance with the Twin of Destiny—how many secrets does she actually know?

text.content: The rune corridor shimmered with ethereal light as azure spirit patterns crawled across the stone walls like living things, each pulse carrying the desolate aura of antiquity. Chen Ji walked across the blue stone surface, the Destiny Chess Piece in his palm burning so intensely he could barely hold it—the searing heat wasn't from temperature but a deeper warning, as if something long dormant was sensing his approach.\n\nAt the corridor's end, a vast underground ruin gradually emerged in his view. Crumbling altars, collapsed stone pillars, and scattered ancient remains all spoke of the glory and carnage that once existed here. Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the agitation in his heart—he hadn't felt such a powerful premonition in a very long time.

dialogue.content: "Be careful." Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged from the Tianji Record, carrying rare gravity. "The prohibitions here are extremely ancient—even I cannot fully see through them. Your Heavenly Fate Value... is already near the critical threshold.\n\nChen Ji sneered silently within his heart. The critical threshold? His Heavenly Fate depletes with every use, yet if he doesn't take this risk, it won't be only him who dies.

text.content:
Chen Ji moved slowly through the ruins, his gaze like a hawk's sweeping every corner. As the "useless" servant of Tianqing Sect, he had long grown accustomed to being overlooked—and this was precisely his greatest advantage. Those so-called geniuses never noticed what a person bent over sweeping saw or heard.

Suddenly, his footsteps halted.

At the end of a hidden diverging path, two sets of footprints remained on the ground—one human, the other carrying an inhuman scent. Near the footprints on the stone wall, someone had carved an extremely small symbol with their fingernails—it was Xuanwu Sect's contact code.

Chen Ji crouched down, his fingertips gently touching that symbol. Beside the code, a faint spiritual light fluctuation remained—the distinctive trace of Xuanwu Sect's secret transmission technique. His eyes narrowed slightly, and he already had his calculations.

There was an insider in the alliance.

And this insider was secretly communicating with some external force. The ruins hadn't even opened yet, and the insider was already making moves... Chen Ji coldly smiled, firmly memorizing this discovery.

The Destiny Chess Piece in his palm burned hot again, ten times more intensely than before.

dialogue.content:
"The time to use the Tianji Record has come." Mo Xiansheng's voice was low. "I sense two consciousnesses approaching—one belonging to the righteous alliance, the other... belonging to no known faction.

Chen Ji closed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurling in his consciousness. He saw the scene three hours later—flames, screams, and a black-robed woman laughing wildly toward the heavens amidst blood.

That woman's face was beautiful beyond compare, yet her eyes were terrifyingly hollow, and there was a bizarre black pattern on her forehead.

text.content:
The Tianji Record's vision receded like a tide, and Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, fine beads of sweat already forming on his forehead. Heavenly Fate Value depleted like flowing water—five points, gone again. His hands trembled slightly but quickly steadied.

Three hours.

He only had three hours to prevent that disaster. And that black-robed woman... if he saw correctly, that was the Holy Sect's signature mark of the Demonic Path—the Soul-Devouring Pattern. A woman capable of wielding such forbidden arts would hold no low position in the Demonic Path.

Chen Ji stood up, his gaze falling upon the darkness in the depths of the corridor.

"Since you're already here..." he murmured, a dangerous curve forming at the corner of his lips, "why not take the initiative to meet them."

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record shows a major upheaval will occur within three hours, with a traitor appearing within the alliance. At this moment, Chen Ji needs to make a critical decision—

choices.text: Conceal one's presence and monitor covertly
choices.description: Do not reveal oneself, first identify the insider's true identity, gather more evidence before acting. Low risk, but may miss the opportunity to strike first.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the first opportunity to make contact with Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete intelligence on the insider
choices.risk_hint: Time is pressing; if the insider acts first, one will fall into a passive situation

text.content:
Chen Ji suppressed his aura, his form moving like a specter into the shadows. His light footwork was second to none among Tianqing Sect's servants—after all, to dodge various duties, one needs some skill, otherwise they'd have died of exhaustion long ago.

However, just as he was about to reach his destination, a faint spatial fluctuation suddenly came from ahead.

Someone had arrived before him.

choices.text: Reveal oneself proactively and make contact with the mysterious faction
choices.description: Present oneself as the "useless" person, proactively approach the probable enemy contact. Seek victory through risk, but may expose one's special attributes.
choices.visible_cost: May expose abilities related to the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent's strength is overwhelming, may fall into danger

text.content:
Chen Ji adjusted his clothing, performing the cowardice and confusion of a "useless servant" to perfection. He deliberately made clumsy footsteps, his shoulders slightly hunched, eyes darting—this act, he had performed in Tianqing Sect for three full years.

"Who... who's there?" His voice carried just the right amount of trembling.

In the shadows, a graceful figure slowly emerged. Black robes like cascading water, beautiful features, and that black pattern on her forehead gleaming with an eerie light in the dim glow—precisely the Demonic Path Holy Maiden shown in the Tianji Record: Ye Qing.

choices.text: Set a trap to lure the insider into the open
choices.description: Deliberately leave false intelligence to lure the insider and their accomplices into appearing. Maximum benefit, but requires meticulous planning and carries the risk of being exposed.
choices.visible_cost: Requires expending extra energy to set up the trap
choices.visible_reward: May capture all traitors in one sweep
choices.risk_hint: If discovered by the sect insider, it will alert the snake

text.content:
A subtle smile tugged at the corner of Chen Ji's lips as his fingers swiftly carved patterns on the stone wall. His movements flowed like clouds and water, with none of the clumsiness a废物 should possess—if anyone witnessed this scene, they would be stunned speechless.

In a moment, a carefully designed piece of false intelligence was set up. As long as someone touched that rune, it would trigger the warning formation Chen Ji had preset.

"Come then," he murmured in his heart. "Let me see who's so eager to deliver themselves to death."

However, just then, an unusual fragrance drifted into his nostrils—sweet, dangerous, carrying a heart-piercing allure. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

Demonic Path Mist. This was the unique concealment technique of the Holy Sect's demons... someone was nearby!

Ye Qing stopped in her tracks, those empty eyes flickering with their first wave of emotion. She stared at Chen Ji, as if regarding a rare treasure, or perhaps as if looking at a ridiculous ant.

"Interesting." Her voice was cold as glacial spring water. "A废物 servant from Tianqing Sect actually managed to see through my Demonic Path Mist?"

Chen Ji raised his head, his face still wearing that timid expression, but his gaze instantly turned sharp as a blade. He knew he had to seize this opportunity—the woman before him might be the key to turning the tables.

"Your Holiness." he said softly, "I have something to show you."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's eyebrows rose slightly. She had encountered too many people who claimed to have "secrets"—some wanting to defect to the Holy Sect for wealth and glory, others trying to buy time with false intelligence. But this废物...

His gaze was far too calm.

A true废物 would not have such eyes when facing the Demonic Path Saint. Unless—he was not afraid of her at all, or he possessed sufficient trump cards that made her unable to act against him.

"What do you want to show me?" Her tone carried scrutiny. "If it's some boring trick, I will make you regret ever being born into this world."

text.content:
Chen Ji said nothing, only raising his right hand. Palm upward, a faint glow emerged from the Tianji Record Fragment at his fingertips—just for an instant, enough for Ye Qing to see clearly.

In that instant, Ye Qing's expression changed.

She stepped back abruptly, the Soul-Devouring Mark on her forehead blazed brilliantly, and the killing intent around her nearly solidified into substance. Yet in the next heartbeat, she forcibly suppressed this force, her chest heaving violently.

"Tianji Record..." Her voice turned hoarse. "Are you a Prophet?"

Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his face reassembling that harmless smile. "Your Holiness, are you now interested in what I have to say?"

choice.prompt: Ye Qing had a strong reaction to the appearance of the Tianji Record, and Chen Ji needs to decide how to establish this alliance—

choices.text: Display the prophecy three hours later
choices.description: Directly show Ye Qing the prophecy from the Tianji Record about her—the scene of her laughing maniacally toward the sky in the firelight. This will shock her, but may also provoke her hostility.
choices.visible_reward: Completely intimidate Ye Qing, gaining her重视
choices.risk_hint: The prophecy content may touch upon Ye Qing's taboos, bringing deadly danger

text.content:
Chen Ji activated the Tianji Record once more, projecting that prophetic vision before Ye Qing's eyes. Firelight, screams, and her own manic laughter in the blood-red chaos—

Ye Qing's body froze rigid. Her lips began to tremble, the Soul-Devouring Mark on her forehead跳动剧烈，仿佛有什么东西想要冲破封印。

"You... how do you have this..." Her voice no longer carried its earlier coldness, but a vulnerability she had never revealed. "This is my... my destiny..."

Chen Ji watched her silently, his mind racing—看来，她确实知道些什么。

choices.description: Don't reveal the prophecy content, but directly propose a trade: you help me uncover the sect insider, I help you break free from the Soul-Devouring Mark's control. A mutually beneficial exchange with lower risk.
choices.visible_cost: Don't expose the Tianji Record's abilities
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may not be satisfied with a superficial transaction and want more

text.content:
"I can help you break free from the Soul-Devouring Mark." Chen Ji's voice was calm and assured. "In exchange, you become my informant in the Demonic Path."

Ye Qing's eyes narrowed. The Soul-Devouring Mark... that was the core method by which the Holy Sect controlled her, something she had tried countless ways to break free from over decades. This废物 servant,凭什么？

But she did not immediately refute. Instead, she carefully examined the man before her. His gaze was far too calm, like an ancient well of unfathomable depth.

"Do you know what the Soul-Devouring Mark is?" she asked.

"I know its weakness." Chen Ji smiled faintly. "And I know, Your Holiness... you are unwilling to be a puppet of the Holy Sect."

choices.text: Imply the Tianji Record is connected to her destiny
choices.description: Tell her the Tianji Record shows she has a blood resonance with some kind of 'destined twin,' implying a massive secret hidden within her. The information is incomplete, but enough to spark her curiosity.
choices.visible_cost: May cause Ye Qing to ask probing questions excessively
choices.visible_reward: Make Ye Qing主动想要接近你
choices.risk_hint: If pressed too deeply, may expose more hidden cards

text.content:
"Your Holiness, have you ever wondered," Chen Ji's voice suddenly dropped lower, "why your Soul-Devouring Mark resonates in this ancient ruins?"

Ye Qing's pupils constricted sharply. Her true purpose for coming here was indeed related to this ancient ruins—the Holy Sect's orders were for her to search for something within the ruins. But this matter, she had never told anyone.

"The Tianji Record shows," Chen Ji spoke each word deliberately, "that Your Holiness has a blood resonance with some kind of 'destined twin.' This resonance is extremely rare, occurring once in a thousand years."

He paused, watching Ye Qing's expression gradually shift, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips.

"So I am curious... Your Holiness, who exactly are you?"

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing fell silent.

After a long moment, she raised her head. For the first time, genuine emotion emerged in those empty eyes—not killing intent, not coldness, but a greed-close渴望。

"Destined twin..." she murmured, repeating these four characters. "So that's it... so that's how it is..."

She suddenly laughed, the smile carrying a hint of madness. "Those old things in the Holy Sect truly hid everything from me. They sent me here, not to search for any ancient treasures—they want to use my blood to break some kind of seal!"

Chen Ji watched her silently, saying nothing. He knew—让子弹再飞一会儿，往往比急于解释更有效果。

"Interesting." Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a hint of appreciation. "This woman indeed has a connection to the Twin of Destiny. Her bloodline seals some kind of ancient power. The Holy Sect's plan to use her is quite well-calculated."

Chen Ji asked in his heart: "Can she be trusted?"

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment: "She is not someone who can be trusted, but she can be used. You share a common goal—rebelling against the Holy Sect. That is enough."

A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. Yes, that was enough.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing was in the midst of emotional turmoil, having just learned the truth of being used by the Holy Sect. Chen Ji needed to decide the next strategy—

choices.description: Propose signing the soul contract while her emotions are fluctuating, binding her completely to your cause. Maximum gains, but may provoke her resentment.
choices.visible_cost: May cause Ye Qing to develop vigilance
choices.risk_hint: Contract backlash risk—if she later betrays you, she will suffer severe damage

text.content:
"Since we share a common enemy," Chen Ji's voice was calm yet powerful, "why not go a step further?"

He raised his hand, and an arcane rune appeared in his palm—that was the mark of the soul contract.

Ye Qing stared at the rune, her eyes filled with complex, indecipherable emotions. The soul contract meant sharing life and death; once signed, she would never be able to betray this man before her.

"You..."

"Does the Saint Maiden not wish to know the truth?" Chen Ji interrupted her. "Sign this contract, and I will tell you everything about the Twin of Destiny."

Ye Qing was silent for a long time. Finally, she reached out her hand and touched the rune.

The contract was sealed.

choices.text: Maintain Distance, Establish a Loose Alliance
choices.description: Do not rush into signing a contract; first maintain the relationship through intelligence sharing and the bond of a common enemy. Lower risk, but weaker binding force.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to fully control Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may change her mind at any time or be recontrolled by the Holy Sect

text.content:
"The Saint Maiden need not rush to make a decision." Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his expression calm. "We can first cooperate through intelligence exchange. Once you truly understand what kind of person I am, we can discuss other matters then."

Ye Qing was slightly stunned. She had expected this man to take advantage of the situation, but she hadn't expected him to voluntarily retreat.

"How generous of you." She snorted coldly, though her tone was not as icy as before.

"Mutual benefit is all." Chen Ji smiled. "Now, let's first discuss the matter of that insider—the people from the Xuanwu Sect are secretly contacting those from the Holy Sect in the ruins. How much does the Saint Maiden know about this?"

Ye Qing's gaze sharpened: "Are you saying... the Holy Sect has planted a chess piece in the alliance?"

Chen Ji briefly told Ye Qing about the process of discovering the insider. After hearing it, her expression became playful.

"Han Lie, the first genius of the Xuanwu Sect?" she laughed lightly. "I've heard of him—a muscle-bound fool with a simple mind. If the Holy Sect wanted to plant an insider in the alliance, they would never use such an obvious target."

"So there is someone else who is the insider." Chen Ji nodded. "The Xuanwu Sect's footprints were merely a decoy; the real traitor lurks in the shadows."

Just then, a commotion echoed from the depths of the passage. Footsteps, shouts, and the roar of some spiritual beast—someone had triggered the ruins' formation.

Chen Ji and Ye Qing exchanged a glance, simultaneously seeing vigilance in each other's eyes.

The three-hour countdown would probably end early.

"Let's go." Chen Ji said in a low voice. "It's time to let those rats hiding in the dark see the light."

In his palm, the light of the Destiny Chess piece was gradually dimming—the Heavenly Fate Value's consumption had begun to backlash. But his eyes were sharper than ever.

This game, he had already arranged. The rest was simply the time to close the net.
